docs.text:
Knowles’s collection of Kashmiri proverbs and sayings with their English meanings and the stories behind them, a source for the folklore and customs of the valley (Bombay, 1885). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A dictionary of Kashmiri proverbs & sayings : explained and illustrated from the rich and interesting folklore of the valley · Knowles, James Hinton · 1885, 280 scanned pages. Published 1885; James Hinton Knowles died 1943; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
